For large cold repo indexing, do not treat CLI timeouts as failure: capture repo index task ids when returned, recover missing ids from repo status <alias>, let service drain active tasks, or run bounded repo index-worker attempts for queued/retrying tasks. Use repo update/index refresh results or status diagnostics instead of assuming task ids. Prefer graph CLI before grep/ripgrep/rg/plain text search unless unavailable, unindexable, inexpressible, or raw regex is required. Do not use for MCP setup/tools, ACP adapters, or protocol-level agent access.
skills.name: relay-knowledge-cli
